records.issue_text: [High/bug] packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:145-152 — The EventManager is constructed from the requesting user (`...user`, `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)`) instead of the booking's organizer; the query at lines 35-39 fetches `booking.user` with `credentials` but they are never used, so any non-organizer caller runs `updateCalendarAttendees` against the organizer's calendar event with the wrong user's credentials — the calendar event won't be updated (or errors out after the DB write).
